scope: Reject invalid SPATIAL_FILTER polygon boundaries at DXF writer admission while retaining simple concave and explicitly closed polygons. This does not establish physical DWG producer support or clipping behavior in a native consumer.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_SpatialFilter::hasValidDxfFields checked finite coordinates, point count and matrix sizes but did not test polygon topology. Autodesk's AcDbSpatialFilter constructor documentation says a boundary with more than two points is a polygon and that the polygon should be non-self-intersecting.

normativeEvidence.source: Autodesk ObjectARX Reference Guide, AcDbSpatialFilter constructor
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Two points are diagonal points of a rectangle; otherwise the points are polygon vertices and the polygon should be non-self-intersecting.

implementationReadiness.change: DXF writer admission checks polygon edge intersections in the 2D boundary coordinates, including non-adjacent crossings/touches and adjacent retracing. It accepts the common explicit closing-point spelling. Near-collinear arithmetic that cannot be classified confidently is refused conservatively. The existing 10,000-point bound limits work; validation is quadratic in the worst case.

coverage: Parser source-field validation accepts a simple concave polygon and a simple polygon with an explicit closing point.
Parser source-field validation and typed writer admission reject a bow-tie polygon.
Typed writer admission rejects adjacent edges that retrace over a segment.
ASCII and Binary SPATIAL_FILTER writers refuse a self-intersecting polygon before emitting any bytes.
Existing rectangle and field-order controls continue to pass.

boundedWorkProbe.input: Locally authored, in-memory 10,000-vertex regular polygon at the existing SPATIAL_FILTER point limit; no DWG/DXF fixture file.
boundedWorkProbe.result: Accepted in 927 ms in the current unoptimized local build.
boundedWorkProbe.interpretation: A single local timing observation only; the implementation remains O(n^2) with the existing 10,000-point cap.

limitations: No physical SPATIAL_FILTER source or DWG-to-DXF end-to-end output was qualified.
The guard validates polygon topology for writer admission only; it does not prove XCLIP inversion, clipping transforms, actual geometry clipping, or native rendering semantics.
Near-collinear ambiguous inputs may be conservatively refused; broad numeric and completed-pool safety qualification remains open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with an independently actionable P6 schema/semantic residual; preserve the separation between DXF field admission and physical-source/native clipping qualification.
